title.text: Remote sensing technicians: collection, image processing, and entry paths

subject.name: Remote Sensing Technicians
subject.summary: Remote sensing technicians assist scientists in using remote sensing technology, collecting spatial data, processing and fusing imagery, and checking the completeness and accuracy of system data; some positions take part in flight planning or sensor configuration. This page corresponds to O*NET19-4099.03, and wage projections cover only the broad 19-4099 category.
